prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production artwork atlas for a Colt Radio fantasy skin. Reference is ONLY the polished illustration quality and square THREE-REGION ATLAS geometry. Create a wholly new theme; NO music objects. Square canvas. TOP y0-33%: wide scenic decorated header background, NO horse in this region; keep center-right reasonably dark for actual live COLT RADIO title, clear top-right for control buttons. MIDDLE y33-53%: seamless rich dark themed material, ornate NARROW decorated side rails along x0-8% and92-100%, center dark clear material, NO horse; this band will repeat vertically along the live player's sides. BOTTOM y53-100%: ONE centered LARGE head-and-shoulders COLT portrait, face angled toward RIGHT in familiar confident three-quarter equine pose, full ears and all head ornament entirely visible with breathing room; entire head starts BELOW y54%. Portrait head is within x30-70%, shoulders may extend x22-78%, lower chest ends canvas bottom. The bottom region has matching dark themed background. Only ONE horse in the ENTIRE source image. No other horse, no duplicated head, no horse on top. NO lettering, logos, UI controls, buttons, station tiles, text, musical instruments, speakers, headphones or turntables. Exquisite decorated premium fantasy game interface painting, detailed materials, rich contrast, dimensional trim, proportional natural horse muzzle. Theme follows: JADE SERPENT PALACE. Header: magnificent ancient emerald/jade imperial palace roofline, gilded roof fins, hanging warm amber lanterns, teal mist in distant mountains; a beautifully carved gold-and-jade SERPENT coils around architectural columns at outer edges and arcs elegantly along the top edge, serpent head at far right, tiny jade leaf carvings and ivory pearl details. Central backdrop dark polished green jade and carved geometric cloud patterns. Middle band: very dark deep emerald stone, gold inlaid cloud carvings, narrow jade pillar side rails wrapped in golden serpentine coils and small luminous jade jewels. Bottom: a unique deep JADE GREY / green-grey horse with long glossy BLACK and EMERALD mane flowing in carefully braided strands, calm clever confident expression, narrow elegant muzzle, bright gold-green eyes. Imperial guardian wearing ornate GOLD and DEEP JADE scale shoulder armor, ivory collar, embroidered emerald mantle, elegant low gold diadem with central jade teardrop and small swept ornamental serpent crests. Crown adapted around visible horse ears. Not a samurai, no helmet/hat/headphones. Restrained jade magical glow at armor joints. Natural horse, not reptile face. Regal intricate eastern fantasy aesthetic, distinct and school-friendly.

jadeAndPhoenix.jadeEmperorEdit: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the clothing and headwear of the ONE horse portrait in the BOTTOM HALF of this Jade Serpent Colt Radio artwork atlas. User rejects warrior armor and wants a CHINESE EMPEROR. Preserve all top palace header, middle jade-and-gold serpent frame band, lighting, layout, source geometry, portrait face/color and pose completely unchanged. Remove all scale armor, armored pauldrons, ornamental serpent diadem and warrior mantle. Dress the jade-grey horse as a regal traditional CHINESE EMPEROR: luxurious flowing IMPERIAL GOLD/YELLOW SILK DRAGON ROBE with large embroidered coiling gold/emerald dragons, swirling clouds and red/teal trim; soft wide cloth shoulders and long silk folds, absolutely NO hard shoulder armor or scales. High rounded court collar, ornate embroidered jade-and-gold chest panel and a neat court bead necklace. Headwear: unmistakable ornate Chinese imperial ceremonial MIANLIU-style crown, small flat horizontal rectangular black-and-gold top board, red silk upright supports, short parallel gold/pearl bead tassels at front and back, adapted around his two visible horse ears. Beads must NOT obscure eyes or muzzle. Imperial crown has majestic proportions but must fit with clear margin entirely below atlas y52%, and within central x27%..73% so live portrait crop fits. Same long black-and-emerald braided mane, calm dignified emperor expression, rich glossy illustration style. Complete crown and ears visible, no cutoff. ONE horse only, only in bottom region. No new horse in header, no text, no buttons, no added UI, no swords, no samurai armor, no European crown. Keep background and original dimensions/aspect EXACTLY the same. This should read as a Chinese emperor wearing an ornate silk dragon robe, not a fantasy soldier.
